data.name: Quinta Maria Cortez Beach Hotel
data.address: C. Sagitario 126, Conchas Chinas, 48390 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
On Sagitario Beach, this quaint B&B in a plush villa is 3 km from the Malecón, a lively promenade along the Pacific Ocean, and 2 km from Olas Atlas.
The 7 dramatic, split-level suites are lavishly furnished with individual decor. All offer free Wi-Fi, kitchenettes, and living rooms with daybeds. Most have beachfront terraces or balconies, and air-conditioning; some add sunken tubs and canopy beds.
Breakfast is served in-room or on a terrace. Other amenities include an outdoor pool and a hot tub with ocean views.
